_label_validation.reader: one reader, contact sheets of 40 random videos per label (5 frames spread over each video), drawn from the videos with an outcome that were processed at the time (all launch and announcement videos plus a third of the others); sheets under tracks/video_files/sheets/

kind_screen.note: misses: an animated diagram, a filmed QR code, an animated graph

kind_person.note: 3 are screen recordings with a webcam inset; 5 more are acted or generated footage of people, not someone talking to the viewer

kind_film.note: the class is broad: motion graphics, title sequences, filmed footage and, for AI companies, showcases of generated video or robots; misses: a talk with slides, a web page, a dashboard graphic, a half person-on-camera video

kind_mixed.note: residual class; 5 are plain screen recordings and 8 are plain films that the 5-frame sample split

kind_slideshow.note: 17 of the first 1,900 videos: too rare to test, not validated

captions.note: 72%: the rest are animated on-screen text, titles or UI text. Recall was not measured, so 'no captions' includes captioned videos the rule missed

scene_changes.note: 2 frames a second: counts a fast animation or a cross-fade as changes; misses zooms and page changes inside white-background screen recordings; two cuts under half a second apart count once; tops out at 120 a minute. Separates no change / occasional / constant, not exact counts

face_share.note: YuNet at 224 px on every frame; not read by eye here (the same detector was 36 of 40 on first frames at 448 px in the video track); small faces in wide shots are missed

first_3_seconds.note: frame at 0 s is the poster frame labelled by the video track (UI 36/40, person 34/40, title 36/40 there); frame at 2.5 s uses the same rule

_meta.evidence: whole videos: previews at 2 frames a second and 224 px (first 180 s), audio at 16 kHz mono (first 90 s), true duration from the fetch metadata; 5,976 video posts with an outcome
_meta.rule:
survives    pairs, ratio and adjusted all exclude no effect, same direction, in LAUNCH (every account), LAUNCH_CF or
              ANNOUNCE with 200+ pairs and 25+ accounts, and pairs and ratio point the same way in BROAD
  broad_only  all three exclude no effect in BROAD (200+ pairs, 25+ accounts) but in no launch set
  leaning     two of three in a launch set or in BROAD, nothing significant the other way
  none / too_thin / not_measured (label failed validation by eye)
  audio traits must also hold with the visual kind held fixed (same-kind pairs exclude 50%, or the adjusted ratio with
  kind dummies excludes 1 when same-kind pairs are under 200); otherwise status "confounded_with_picture".
Grades: A survives and the pairs interval excludes 50% both before and from 2026-04-23; B survives; C broad_only.
